invariants: Ready and Secure must be independently meaningful input decisions, never reverse-engineered from safe/out.
A versioned model that changes reception outcome is an execution migration, never metadata repair.
No BaseTouch/Tag or retirement inferred only from receive completion.
No scorer owner or GameRecord ledger parallel to Sprint5.

prerequisites: Close the existing SS execution-copy validation gap before adding any new receiver facts.
Approve exact new receive demand and capability mapping; no default incoming location mapping from legacyUsableDelivery.
Provide readiness source and coarse relative units for each direct and relay leg.
Predeclare expected execution changes and scorer changes separately.
Build pending/executed/settled new-version admission before feature activation.

versionAdmission.oldPending: Keep legacy by default. Opt-in conversion only before first execution with explicit version recorded; absent field stays legacy.
versionAdmission.oldExecuted: Never rerun or silently upgrade. Validate and replay the originally owned cache/sample/actor snapshot.
versionAdmission.oldSettled: Never rebuild or backfill GameRecord/evaluation; retain old scorer/evidence.
versionAdmission.newPending: Record approved authority version at admission and bind route/actor/physical identities.
versionAdmission.newExecuted: Only matching version resolver validates exact stored inputs/stages; no fallback to legacy on error.
versionAdmission.newSettled: Exactly-once owner; stored official record not regenerated on reload.
versionAdmission.unknownVersion: Reject or defer explicitly; do not infer stages from legacy fields.
versionAdmission.missingNewFacts: Reject new-version admission; leave old-version insufficiency explicit.

migrationPlan.activation: Not implemented this Sprint. Human review required on execution changes; no automatic next Sprint.
